summary: Tested operator access to Dati azienda + banche (new default diritti dati_azienda/banche=True for non-admin). Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (default diritti in /auth/me and /users, GET /companies scoped to company_ids, operator PUT /company with anagrafica + 2 banks persisted incl. IBAN/ABI, non-assigned company denied, admin-only endpoints 403, revoke banche -> banks untouched, revoke dati -> anagrafica untouched/banks editable, revoke both -> 403). UI: operator login, company switcher lists only the 2 assigned companies, switching works (localStorage fe_company_id), Dati azienda page editable, add bank + save -> PUT 200 and persisted after reload, switcher label refreshed after save, /aziende and /utenti redirect to /dashboard, with banche=false the BanksCard is hidden and save still 200. Found and FIXED one bug: POST /api/auth/login response lacked 'diritti', so right after login (without page reload) the operator sidebar hid 'Impostazioni > Dati azienda' (and Magazzino/Produzione). All TEST data cleaned up.

minor.endpoint: GET/PUT /api/company with X-Company-Id of a non-assigned company
minor.issue: Returns 404 'Azienda non trovata' (tenant()) rather than 403 as stated in the review request. Access is correctly denied; 404 avoids leaking existence. Only a spec mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: login response had no diritti -> can(user,'dati_azienda') false until reload, menu 'Dati azienda' missing right after login

issues: No loading state: form shows empty inputs until GET /company returns; user edits typed before the response are silently overwritten by the loaded data (observed during testing). Consider a loading skeleton/disable inputs until loaded.

action_items: Review the fix in server.py login(): now returns {**user, 'diritti': diritti(user)} (keep it)
Optional: loading state on Settings page to avoid overwriting edits typed before GET /company resolves
Note: users that already have an explicit diritti document (saved via DirittiDialog before) keep their stored values and do not get the new default; currently 0 such non-admin users in DB
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >5000 lines - should be split into modules

DirittiIn defaults all fields to False: a partial PUT /users/{id}/diritti silently revokes omitted rights (e.g. articoli_magazzino). DirittiDialog sends all keys so UI is fine, but API callers may be surprised.
seed_data_creation: TEST_OpA/OpB/OpC_Other and TEST_UI_Alfa/Beta/Other companies + TEST operator users created and deleted by id
context_for_next_testing_agent: Operators are created via admin POST /api/users (send_invite=false) then password_hash set in mongo with bcrypt. Run pytest -n0. Valid test IBANs: IT60X0542811101000000123456, IT42L1234512345123456789012. Non-assigned company returns 404.
rca of the issue: EmailAuthForm stores the POST /auth/login response as user; login returned USER_PROJ doc without the computed 'diritti' (only /auth/me added it). Layout hides menu items with a 'diritto' when can(user,k) is false, so Dati azienda was hidden until reload. Fix: login returns diritti too.
